name: Macho Harvest ~ Muscular Harvest Puzzle ~
detailed_description:
A super chaotic puzzle game of macho x agriculture! ?

Let's raise various kinds of machos that are born by sowing protein in the field with care and love and ship them!

■Story

The director of the macho farm loves muscles so much that he ends up opening a ``macho farm.''

Bury a mysterious seed called ``Macho Seed'' in the soil and feed it with protein instead of water.

A few days later, small dumbbell buds will appear, and the scent of muscles will fill the entire field.

People from the next town say: "Isn't there some kind of protein wind blowing?"

The grown machos work hard on squats and bench presses every day, Gradually, your pectoral muscles will grow and your abdominal muscles will start to crack...

■Only 3 steps to ship!

①Put protein in the field

Macho will be born by sowing 3 types of proteins in the field!

A variety of macho colors can be created by combining colors...?

② Cultivate macho character

By giving more protein to the newly born macho, the level will increase!

Let's grow it well and prepare for shipping!

③Shipping together

Get a high score by shipping many machos at once!

Let's grow muscle well according to the shape of protein!
